trickyParts: The mapping is an exhaustive Record<LegionRole, GitHubAppRole> (architect/planner/tester/reviewer → review; implementer/merger → implement) so a new LegionRole fails to compile until placed; there is no runtime 'Unknown worker mode' path any more because every caller passes a validated LegionRole.

api.test.ts 'reissues a daemon-registered worker session capability…' is a tester and now pins the review identity on /worker/started, /gh-token (tokenRoles === ['review','review']) and /git-credential; the 'registers a worker session…' case pins gitName legion-review[bot]. Nothing else in the suite depended on the old mapping (1115 pass).

A pane's global git config routes https://github.com through `!gh auth git-credential`, and `gh` on a pane PATH is the Legion shim: any git push from a pane silently redeems THAT pane's grant, whatever token the test meant to use. The proof driver isolates git with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; run 1 of the proof was contaminated that way (its branch legion42-proof/2026-09-13T10-17-43-805Z was deleted).

Non-pushing roles: the review App answers `git push` with `remote: Repository not found` (not the REST 403 text) — the negative control checks the remote head is unchanged rather than matching the message.
deviations: The production-like proof ran the workspace build's real Legion API (`startLegionApi` + real TokenManager, real GitHub) driven over HTTP as the extension does, with in-memory state and no NATS/Dispatch/tmux/OMP panes — those are not on the changed path. The tester may repeat it through a full rig; the driver was a throwaway under /tmp and is not committed.

Spec v2 acceptance 3 asked for a tester commit status; the review App has no `statuses` permission (GET /app) so that POST 403s. The architect changed acceptance 3 in spec v3 to check run + PR comment and recorded 'add statuses to the review App' under Rejected; neither App's permissions were touched.

notesForTester: Acceptance 3 (spec v3): a tester grant's check run and PR comment on the sandbox PR are legion-reviewer[bot]; do not post a commit status (the review App has no statuses permission by design).

Acceptance 6: your handoff commit stays local — do not push; the implementer's next push carries it. A `jj git push` from your role is refused (`Repository not found` / `Resource not accessible by integration`) and that is expected.

Any git push from a pane goes through the pane's own grant via the gh shim credential helper; to test another identity's push, isolate git from the global config (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null) and supply the token via GIT_ASKPASS.
